scope: Static independent implementation review before common target evaluation; no result audit

findings.detail: Naive cumsum divided by weights.sum differs from the pinned ENSANUT compensated cumulative accumulation with q*cumulative[-1] threshold. Inverse-CDF boundary selection can change by an order statistic; the prescribed quantile convention must be matched. No new test was run.

The audit does not require the complete expected contrast set, exact scheduled constructor/seed product, or endpoint ID sets. It does not audit construction_summaries, arm summaries, or incomplete_available_value_contrast. Complete contrast arithmetic itself uses the correct constructor-first averaging.

Successful generation with a preserved primary provider_error is independently recalculated and then expected to have computed primary endpoints. This reports legitimate unavailable failure records as numeric mismatches rather than distinguishing provider failure from incorrect arithmetic. It must not trigger replacement, retry or estimand changes.
